text: Hello, I have five years of backend engineering experience at scale.
We scaled our API to fifty thousand requests per second using Redis caching.
I carefully evaluated the database trade-offs between consistency and availability.
The main issue was garbage collection pauses... which caused latency spikes.
We deployed our microservices onto Kubernetes with Envoy service mesh.
We restructured the microservices to reduce round-trip serialization overhead.
We partitioned the PostgreSQL ledger table by month to optimize query execution.
Excuse me, could you clarify that question?
Our tech stack used Kafka, Raft, gRPC, PostgreSQL, and AWS S3 with strict ACID compliance.
